title: The Path Cleared of Fallen Leaves
youtube_title: The Path Cleared of Fallen Leaves | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Kindness is helping carry what feels too heavy.
summary: At a cottage porch and the hall just inside, a smooth path hiding under a skirt of dry leaves is awkward for one person. Chioma notices Cousin Pio struggling and takes a useful half of the job without asking to be praised.
